_note: Where to cancel/restart each subscription, by who bills it. US only. Researched 2026-09-29 from each provider's own help pages ('source'). 'verified': false = path inferred from help-page steps, not confirmed as a direct URL. These change; recheck before shipping.

Netflix.note: If billed by T-Mobile, Verizon, Comcast, Apple or Google, the Cancel button may not appear; cancel with the billing partner.

HBO Max.note: Sign in, choose Cancel Your Subscription. No cancel option = third-party billed; the page names who bills it.

Disney+.note: Account > Subscription > select Disney+ > Cancel Subscription. Billing partner is shown under Your Plans & Billing.

Peacock.note: Account > Plans & Payment > Cancel Plan. Third-party billed (Apple, Google, Roku, Amazon, Xfinity...) must cancel there.

Paramount+.note: Click Cancel Subscription on the account page.

Prime Video.note: Usually part of Amazon Prime. Cancelling Prime drops shipping and every other Prime benefit too, so most users won't rotate it.

Apple TV+.note: Always billed by Apple, or by a partner (Amazon Channels, a carrier).

Apple.note: On iPhone: Settings > your name > Subscriptions. The iOS link opens the same screen directly.

Google Play.note: Add ?package=<app id>&sku=<product id> to open one subscription directly.

Amazon.note: Covers Prime Video Channels add-ons (e.g. 'HBO Max Amazon Channel').

Roku.note: Manage subscription > Turn off auto-renew. Access continues to the end of the billing cycle.

YouTube.note: YouTube TV add-ons are under tv.youtube.com > Settings > Membership instead.

Xfinity.note: Help article, not a direct account page. Cancelling StreamSaver ends access IMMEDIATELY, not at the end of the cycle.

Verizon.note: My Verizon > Products & plan perks > select the perk > Unsubscribe. myPlan contracts may require keeping at least one perk.

exceptions.note: Roku processes the charge but Disney+/Hulu manage the subscription; Roku can't cancel it.
